SUMMARY.md:
> The Joplin Data API, served by the Clipper Server that the Joplin desktop application runs locally. Scoped here to the three core item types: notes, folders (notebooks) and tags.
>
> Unofficial definition, authored by Voxgig from the published Joplin REST API reference. Not an official Joplin document.
ID of the parent notebook, empty for a top-level notebook.
Tells whether the note is a conflict or not.
Tells whether this note is a to-do or not.
The Clipper Server, enabled in Joplin under Options, Web Clipper.
The Web Clipper authorisation token, shown in Joplin under Options, Web Clipper.
The note body, in Markdown. May also contain HTML.
When the folder was created. May differ from `created_time` as the user can set it.
When the folder was last updated.
When the tag was created. May differ from `created_time` as the user can set it.
When the tag was last updated.
When the tag was last updated. May differ from `updated_time` as the user can set it.
